executiveAssessment.text: Executive Conclusion — JW Marriott Hotel Monterrey Valle reaches many monitored demand scenarios, but consideration consistency is the binding constraint. Why this is the primary issue — Scenario Presence is 92.1% while AI Consideration is 45.2%. The hotel is therefore relevant across a wide share of monitored traveler needs, yet it is not carried into individual answers nearly as consistently. Softness concentrates in Family Travel versus stronger Business Travel. AC Hotel by Marriott Monterrey Valle often fills absences in those weaker contexts. That contrast is more important than either metric alone. Broad scenario reach without consistent answer-level inclusion means the hotel is known in the demand set but not reliably carried into traveler-facing answers. Management attention should start with consistency of representation, not with assuming the hotel needs an entirely new competitive set. Where the pattern is concentrated — Scenario Capture is softest in Family Travel (60.0%) versus stronger Adventure (100.0%). These are current-period scenario-capture rates from demandCapture.byIntent — not answer-level consideration. When the property is absent, the leading observed alternative is AC Hotel by Marriott Monterrey Valle (2 monitored scenarios). Counts are observational and do not establish causation. Reality Coverage is 46.7% (7 of 15 monitored attributes recognized). High-severity gaps include 24-Hour Fitness Center; Financial Center Location; Aimbridge Managed. What management should focus on — Focus first on consistency of representation for Family Travel. Confirm priority sources present the same use cases and attributes that appear in scenarios where the hotel is absent, and close gaps that repeatedly coincide with answer-level misses. What not to overreact to — No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet. This period can be evaluated on its own; change over time is not shown. Independent Positioning shows #1 of 9 with Portfolio AI Presence 45.2%. Portfolio and Core metrics share observation context but are not interchangeable denominators. What to watch next — Compare high-presence versus low-consideration scenarios and inspect which sources and attributes appear when the hotel is missing. Use that evidence pack before changing channel strategy. Anchored metrics (current published ADP): AI Consideration 45.2%; Scenario Presence 92.1%; Reality Coverage 46.7%. Biggest Strength (platform): Often placed near the top when AI ranks hotels. Biggest Constraint (platform): Not appearing consistently in AI answers.

biggestStrength.body: Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, JW Marriott Hotel Monterrey Valle appeared in the Top 3 93.1% of the time. This shows how prominently the hotel is positioned when AI includes it.

biggestConstraint.headline: Not appearing consistently in AI answers
biggestConstraint.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 92.1% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 45.2% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.
